correctness.rationale: Under the source definition, the Caputo–Fabrizio derivative of an absolutely continuous trajectory tends to zero at the initial time. Continuity therefore requires the autonomous vector field to vanish at the prescribed initial state. The source parameters give the exact nonzero residual \( (109/1000,27/1000,-2) \). Independently, the exact exponentially weighted-memory increment contains both an old-history term and a weighted new-interval term; the source step replacing it by an unweighted new-interval integral is algebraically false. A constant-input calculation provides an exact counterexample to that replacement. The claim is limited to the equations and regularity actually printed.

value.rationale: The article’s principal scientific claims concern fractional-order HIV trajectories, oscillations, and chaotic-looking behavior generated by the displayed recurrence. The explicit initial data do not define a solution of the displayed fractional IVP, and the numerical derivation independently changes and then mishandles the history term. These are not cosmetic normalization issues: they sever the link between the plotted trajectories and the mathematical model. The result also identifies exactly what any corrected formulation must address—initial compatibility and a consistent memory update.
